lines.trans: Who will thread the needle for me?
Dad will help us right now.
Give it here, I will thread it quickly.
Today is precisely your turn to help.
Well, the thread is already in place.
Thanks. And how do you like the costume?
On top the costume looks simply super!
And on the bottom I would change a bit.
Why change anything there?
Just a tiny bit, the bare minimum.
Are the pants too long for Slavik?
Yes, need to hem it a time or two.
The main thing is that the children perform well.
We will make everything beautiful, don't worry.

Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'лноваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to worry'.

meanings.en: to insert, to fit, to put in
meanings.note: Вставить чип = fit a microchip. Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'тавить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to insert, to put in', paired with 'вставлять'.

examples.trans: Put the key in the lock.

examples.text: Это ты виноват! Лютику надо вставить чип.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'глядеть'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to look, appear'.

examples.trans: On top the costume looks simply super!

examples.trans: Do not say that, you look wonderful!

meanings.en: to perform on stage, speak publicly
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'ступить'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to perform, speak publicly'.

examples.trans: The main thing is that the children perform well.

examples.text: От страха у меня уже пот выступил.
examples.trans: From fear sweat has already broken out on me.

изменить.gloss: to cheat on, to betray; to change

meanings.en: to cheat on, to be unfaithful to
meanings.note: + dative (кому). Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.

+ accusative (что). Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.

examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you.

examples.text: Эдик, я хотела тебе изменить. С ним, чтобы отомстить.
examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you. With him, to take revenge.

meanings.note: Question word. Core Russian adv meaning 'how; as' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: Самую малость = just a tiny bit. Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common feminine noun meaning 'trifle, small bit' in everyday Russian.
